name: barebones3d
description: Barebones 3D - Engineering Diagnostic Hubs, Parametric CAD & Obsolete OEM Repair Platform

scripts.sync:site: rm -rf site/generator/* && cp -r generator/dist/* site/generator/ && sed 's|\./assets/|/generator/assets/|g' generator/dist/index.html > site/generator.html
scripts.build: npm run build:generator && npm run sync:site && npm run build:guides
scripts.test: npm run test:generator && npm run test:platform
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy site --project-name barebones3d --branch main
